user.title: Dynamic Energy Tariff Compare
user.description: Compare a dynamic 15-min spot-price electricity tariff (Tibber, Rabot Energy, Octopus, …) with your fixed tariff. All ct/kWh values are gross (incl. VAT), except the spot price, which gets VAT applied. The defaults are examples only. Enter the values of your provider and grid operator.

data.provider_name: Provider name (optional, e.g. Tibber, Rabot Energy, Octopus)
data.energy_entity: Grid import energy sensor (kWh, e.g. EDL21 total active energy / OBIS 1.8.0)
data.price_entity: Price sensor (optional: EPEX Spot, Nord Pool, provider integration, …)
data.price_is_final: Price sensor already is the final all-in price (no VAT/surcharges added)
data.use_energy_charts: Fetch DE-LU spot prices from energy-charts.info if no price sensor is selected
data.fixed_price_ct: Current fixed tariff: energy price (ct/kWh, gross)
data.fixed_base_fee_eur_month: Current fixed tariff: base fee (€/month, gross)
data.provider_markup_ct: Dynamic tariff: provider markup on the spot price (ct/kWh, gross)
data.levies_ct: Taxes & levies: Stromsteuer, Konzessionsabgabe, Umlagen (ct/kWh, gross)
data.vat_percent: VAT applied to the spot price (%)
data.provider_monthly_fee_eur: Dynamic tariff: provider monthly fee (€/month, gross)
data.grid_base_fee_eur_month: Dynamic tariff: grid base fee + metering (€/month, gross)

data_description.provider_name: Only used for display (device and entry name). Entity IDs stay the same.
data_description.price_entity: Leave empty to use energy-charts.info. 15-min price lists are read from attributes (EPEX Spot `data`, Nord Pool `raw_today`/`raw_tomorrow`, …); otherwise the current state is used per slot. Unit is detected from unit_of_measurement (€/kWh, ct/kWh, €/MWh).
data_description.price_is_final: Off: sensor is the raw (net) spot price -> VAT, markup, grid fee and levies are added. On: the sensor already contains everything (e.g. your provider's own integration, or EPEX Spot total price with surcharges configured) -> used as is.
data_description.provider_markup_ct: See your provider's price sheet / tariff calculator for your postcode. The default is only an example.
data_description.network_fee_ct: Depends on your grid operator / postcode; shown in the price breakdown of most dynamic-tariff providers. The default is only an example.
data_description.provider_monthly_fee_eur: The default is only an example.

error.unknown_price_unit: The price sensor has no recognised unit (€/kWh, ct/kWh, €/MWh) and no price list attributes.
error.no_price_source: Select a price sensor or enable energy-charts.info.

abort.already_configured: This energy sensor is already configured.
